name: PIRANHAS_ST_BITE
meaning: glued to Ralph's position; the first attacker plays anim 1 and sends Wolf msg 0 arg 9 on entry

name: PIRANHAS_ST_ATTACK_WAIT
meaning: Ralph frozen (msg 0xE); 1000 ms timer, then BITE

name: PIRANHAS_ST_SWIM
meaning: 2-point path to a random point 200-399 below the surface, 500 u/s

name: PIRANHAS_ST_LEAP
meaning: 4-point path whose middle 500 units run 50 below the surface; anim 3 plus a splash on the way up, anim 2 plus a splash on the way down
